## Working for the Treasury

After 4+ years at the Treasury, I'm still not entirely sure what's kosher to talk about publicly. Suffice to say I'm working on some long-term issues which also happen to be relevant for the (rapidly approaching) post-election period. Thinking about managing energy going into this period, since we're on the thin end of the wedge: on the incline until Budget, at the earliest.
